payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit ee027ab). Push delivery is wired end-to-end: create_frick_server builds the PushRegistry (APNs/FCM/WebPush over real reqwest transports + test adapter) + NotificationRouter, registers the push.deliver handler into the JobHandlerRegistry the durable worker resolves from, starts the JobWorker in listen(), and exposes registry+router on AppState for admin_push. A BootSeams seam injects recording transports so the enqueue->worker->router->adapter->transport path is proven offline (push_wiring.rs: the job Completes, not dead-lettered). Real reqwest transports (APNs HTTP/2+ES256, FCM OAuth2 v1, WebPush ece+VAPID) with request-construction tests; the WebPush send-time SSRF DNS re-screen (FR-264 follow-up) is now closed. Unverifiable here: live network delivery to Apple/Google. Follow-up: config.jobs.* poll/batch knobs not wired (worker uses defaults).
